actions.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The mountaineer critically fails a check to Balance or Climb

Effect Training kicks in, and the mountaineer catches themself, improving the check from a critical failure to a failure.
actions.name: Lost My Footing
actions.trigger: The mountaineer critically fails a check to Balance or Climb

actions.description: The mountaineer Interacts to draw their hatchet or pick, then Strikes with the weapon.
actions.name: Quick Draw

actions.description:
Requirements A creature is undetected by one or more of the mountaineer's allies but is observed by the mountaineer

Effect The mountaineer Points Out an enemy and makes a Strike against them.
actions.name: Team Awareness
actions.requirements: A creature is undetected by one or more of the mountaineer's allies but is observed by the mountaineer

actions.description: The mountaineer Strides twice and Leaps up to 20 feet horizontally.
actions.name: Chasm Crossing

actions.description: The mountaineer ignores difficult terrain caused by ice or snow.
actions.name: Arctic Passage

actions.description: A mountaineer isn't impeded by difficult terrain caused by snow or ice. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Balance on slippery ice.
actions.name: Experienced Steps

actions.description: While climbing, the mountaineer can have up to five allies Following the Expert and grants a +3 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Climb.
actions.name: Professional Climber

actions.description: During an avalanche, the mountaineer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Reflex save against bludgeoning damage and natural disasters.
actions.name: Tuck and Roll

name: Mountaineer
publicNotes:
Mountaineers usually travel solo, but some guide expeditions into dangerous terrain.

Explorers are often well-equipped and well-trained for any type of hazard and are eager to lead others into the wild.
